estimates.rationale: Foundational single-SKU-at-location CRUD; requires DB schema (stock table), API boundary (file/retrieve endpoints), service layer (stock filing logic), repository layer, and SPA form + list view; establishes project-wide layering conventions.

In-place quantity adjustment with validation (no-below-zero) and metadata preservation (timestamp/actor); depends on FP1 schema; no new entities, lighter than FP1 (update endpoint + optimistic SPA refresh).

Introduces supplier entity, inbound receipt event tracking, and multi-entity relationships; requires new schema tables (receipt, supplier), API endpoints, business logic for stock aggregation, and receipt form UI.

Introduces order/pick entities, outbound event tracking, and overcommit constraint enforcement at write time; requires new schema (order, pick), validation service layer, and rejection messaging in SPA.
Aggregation and detail view for one SKU across multiple locations; primarily a query optimization (GROUP BY location) and SPA detail page; no new core entities or business logic, reuses FP1 schema.
